scenes.zh: arXiv 每天上新几百篇论文。光看标题，就要花掉你一个小时。
scenes.en: Hundreds of new papers land on arXiv every day. Just skimming the titles can eat a whole hour.

scenes.zh: PaperScroll，像刷短视频一样刷论文。
scenes.en: Meet PaperScroll: scroll papers like short videos.

scenes.zh: 一屏一篇，上滑就是下一篇。关键配图，加上问题、方法、结果三句话，几秒钟看懂一篇论文。
scenes.en: One paper per screen. Swipe up for the next. The key figure, plus the problem, the method and the result. Get a paper in seconds.

scenes.zh: 中了哪个会、是什么级别、被引用了多少次，一眼就知道。
scenes.en: Which venue, what level, how many citations. All at a glance.

scenes.zh: 双击喜欢，推荐会越刷越懂你；每一篇都告诉你，为什么推荐给你。
scenes.en: Double-tap what you like, and the feed learns your taste. Every card even tells you why it was picked.

scenes.zh: 想细读，就打开精读，摘要按句子着色；喜欢的论文，一键导出 BibTeX。
scenes.en: Want more? Close reading colours the abstract sentence by sentence, and your favourites export to BibTeX in one tap.

scenes.zh: 一切都跑在你自己的电脑上。不用注册，不用付费，数据不出门。
scenes.en: And it all runs on your own computer. No sign-up, no fees, and your data never leaves home.

scenes.zh: PaperScroll，受 PaperDance 启发，开源免费。现在就去 GitHub 试试吧。
scenes.en: PaperScroll. Inspired by PaperDance. Free and open source. Try it today on GitHub.
